Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologia informației și servicii informatice
GENERAL SUMMARY: 
 As an Sr. eCommerce Business Intelligence, you will build analyses that help American Greeting Interactive (AGI) make sound decisions. You’ll collaborate with eCommerce teams from an array of other disciplines (Marketing, Merchandising, Product, Creative, Data, etc.) to develop solutions and analyses related to customer behavior that will inform the decision making for our products. You will work with the data warehouse and the BI team to run SQL queries over large datasets, analyze results and help automate processes through various RPA (Robotic Process Automation) or non-RPA tools. You will also be responsible for critically reviewing reports and data for completeness and accuracy. This role requires a quantitative, creative, critical thinker with a mindset for continual learning and customer focus. 
 Prior experience in an eCommerce analytical role is preferred but not required. 
 ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 • Drive better decision making by creating decision support tools that range from BI dashboards to 
 interactive analytical applications 
 • Analyze large data sets by quantifying the data quality, identifying partular patterns and visualizing the results in Tableau 
 • Perform tasks such as data wrangling, A/B test design and analysis, statistical modeling, data mining, segmentation, clustering, data visualization, or basic data analysis tasks as needed 
 • Surface performance insights and opportunities across all of AG ecommerce businesses to inform decisions and drive positive change within the organization and/or the consumer experience 
 • Provide direction to the data warehouse staff to identify required data and infrastructure for reporting and analyses. Also includes working with data warehouse staff on data quality issues, metadata, etc. 
 Education Required :
 • Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Economics, Business Analytics, or similar discipline. Degree major 
 secondary to hands-on experience managing or performing an analytical role. 
 Required Length & Type of Experience: 
 · 5+ years expereince in scripting with SQL and/or experience in analytical coding and software packages such as R, or Python 
 · 3+ years expeirence with data visulization tools: Power BI, Tableau 
 · Experience with Alteryx is a plus 
 · Experience with e-commerce and Google Analytics or similar web analytics platform is a plus 
 Knowledge, Skills & Abilities: 
 • Skilled at visual information presentation and dashboard creation and management 
 • Exceptional analytical and problem solving skills 
 • Strong written and oral communication skills 
 • Possess individual initiative, creativity, and passion for quantitative analytics 
 • Ability to handle multiple projects at once as well as plan and prioritize work 
 • Good time management skills and ability to complete projects with less oversight 
 • A genuine interest in innovation 
 About AMERICAN GREETINGS 
 American Greetings is a creator and manufacturer of innovative social expression products that assist consumers in enhancing their relationships to create Happiness, Laughter and Love. American Greetings’ major greeting card lines are American Greetings, Carlton Cards, Gibson, Recycled Paper Greetings and Papyrus. We also own large web collections of greetings on the Web @ AmericanGreetings.com, Cardstore.com Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, American Greetings has offices worldwide in Canada, UK -Europe, Australia, Asia and generates annual revenue of approximately $1.9 billion. 
 The Bucharest Office is one of AG’s IT Centers that offers support for the Corporation Teams in Web & Mobile Development, Data warehouse, System Engineering, Customer Support, Financial Operations and SAP areas. We are a young, ambitious and dynamic team, growing together with the company through high training offered by our specialists in a variety of technologies across all platforms: 
 • Python, Java, C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Endeca, SAP, Node JS, Android, iOS –Web & Mobile; 
 • Oracle, SQL, Informatica, Teradata, ETL, Unix/Shell Scripting, QlikView –Data Warehouse; 
 • Linux, Microsoft Windows -Active Directory, Exchange 2010, VM-Ware –System Admin; 
 • SAP ABAP, SAP MM, FICO, SAP Java. 
 We are in Cotroceni Business Center –close to Politechnica University and AFI. 
 Join us and you’ll discover nice people, a team of professionals and a place where you come to work with pleasure ☺
